description: 1 master suite, 1 single bedroom, 1 bathroom with bathtub, 1 shower bathroom, 1 WC, open plan living-kitchen-dining, 1 storage room. Corner-aspect apartment — windows on top and left facade(s). Kitchen is on an interior wall away from windows — less natural light at the cooking position. 1 master suite (en-suite bathroom, no walk-in wardrobe), 1 single bedroom(s). Single bedrooms can each function as bedroom, home office, hobby room or guest room. Kitchen: galley, no island. Cook faces the wall, back to the living and dining area. No wall separates kitchen from dining and living — fully open plan. Living area arrangement: linear kitchen-dining-living. Dining table visible, approximately 6 seats. Bathroom config: 1 bathroom(s) with bathtub; 1 shower-only bathroom(s); 1 WC-only room(s) (toilet, no shower or bath). Parallel morning routines possible — separate shower and WC available. Master suite close to entry and kitchen — convenient morning access, less acoustic separation from activity. 0 of 1 single bedroom(s) have a desk visible in plan. The single bedroom is large enough to accommodate a bunk bed for two children. Possible configurations — mutually exclusive: (1) all as children's bedrooms; (2) all as home offices or hobby rooms; (3) one or both as guest rooms; (4) bunk bed arrangement extending household capacity. Storage room adjacent to kitchen — usable as kitchen pantry, laundry room or general storage. Entry area has space for coat and shoe storage. From entry: kitchen is immediate, living area is short corridor. Door separates entry corridor from living area. Suits: couples needing a spare room, households with parallel morning routines.
